scientific_question: Can the accepted Hindsight dependency body be supplemented with its exact public registry sources without changing any dependency byte?
decision_informed: Whether a subsequent hash-enforced Linux wheelhouse acquisition can preserve the official uv.lock source semantics.
scientific_evidence_role: Dependency-source metadata evidence only; no download, installation, model, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is eligible.

diagnosed_need.risk_if_omitted: torch==2.10.0+cpu cannot be reproduced from the default PyPI index alone and substituting torch sources would change the dependency evidence identity.

acceptance: All frozen source, uv.lock, uv, Python, and accepted dependency-body identities match.
Two source-aware exports are byte-identical and source and lock remain unchanged.
The export contains exactly the two required credential-free HTTPS public source URLs and no other source.
After removing only the source-directive prefix, every dependency-body byte equals the accepted 256006-byte reference with SHA-256 6f0836431e1a0ba74bdc92732ffb0a81a1c72691bdab2bc3fba43c4a1e3716c6.
The export retains exactly 208 requirement heads, no workspace reference, and mutually consistent terminal evidence.
failure: Any collision, identity mismatch, missing or unexpected source, credential, non-HTTPS URL, dependency-body change, cardinality change, source mutation, lock mutation, command failure, or timeout seals the fresh root TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves it.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit the source-aware requirements artifact, then freeze but do not start its platform-specific hash-enforced wheelhouse acquisition until the Wave1 resource gate is terminally accepted.
prohibited_actions: editing or deleting any prior rejected or accepted export evidence
adding a mirror, private index, credential, alternate torch build, or changed dependency byte
downloading wheels, installing packages, downloading models, or starting a Hindsight service
using this engineering stage to populate a numerical comparison cell or claim SOTA
